entities.name: Angélica Palma
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Angélica Palma y Román was a Peruvian writer, journalist and biographer who was part of the Modernist movement and one of the founders of the feminist movement in her country. She was the daughter of the renowned intellectual Ricardo Palma and the half-sister of the writer Clemente Palma.
